title: Target anatomy
view: Sagittal section of the right lateral chest wall in the mid-axillary line at the 4th-5th ribs, as on the screen: cranial on the image left, skin at the top.
teachingPoint: Latissimus over serratus over the ribs: inject in the superficial plane (between latissimus and serratus, with the thoracodorsal artery) or the deep plane (between serratus and the ribs).
claims: Sagittal section, cranial on the left (NYSORA's serratus plate, concept only).
Layers: latissimus dorsi, serratus anterior, ribs, pleura (record).
Thoracodorsal artery in the superficial plane (record).
Solid teal: the superficial plane; dashed teal: the deep plane under serratus (record: either option).
Needle in-plane from cranial, tip in the superficial plane short of the artery (record: cranial to caudal).
Labels: Latissimus dorsi, Serratus anterior, Thoracodorsal artery, Superficial plane, Deep plane.

geometry.why: in-plane from the cranial end (cranial is left)
